newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian o/n rates widen, one week narrows.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian o/n rates widen, one week narrows.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound widened to between 10 and 10 5/16 percent on Monday from 10 1/8 to 10 1/4 percent on Sunday, bankers said.
One banker mentioned 9 1/2 percent, but other bankers said that transaction did not reflect market prices.
One-week rates narrowed to between 10 1/8 and 10 5/16 percent, compared with between 10 1/8 and 10 3/8 on Sunday.
State-owned banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rate at 10 1/2 percent.
